SELECT
last_access_month AS "key",
last_access_day AS "key",
last_access_hour AS "key",
last_access_hour AS "key",
COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS "count"
COUNT(id) AS "count"
FROM sys_login_session WHERE 1 = 1
AND last_access_year = #{year}
GROUP BY last_access_month
AND last_access_month = #{month}
GROUP BY last_access_day
AND last_access_day = #{day} GROUP BY last_access_hour
